## About
AMS Autowerks is a repair and performance shop on Cantor Ave in Linden. Maintenance, tuning, exhaust and body work, all under one roof.
The team is not big. Diogo is on the important work himself, with help on prep and the smaller jobs. One reviewer called him "like a surgeon."
Call or email info@amsautowerks.com. Rated 4 on Google from 107 reviews.

## Services
- Maintenance and tuning: Maintenance and tuning work, handled by a small, focused team.
- Engine, transmission and haldex oil service: Oil service on the engine, transmission and haldex. One Audi owner also had a rear sway bar put in.
- Body shop: Body work is done here too, alongside the mechanical side.

## FAQ
Q: Can you match old paint?
A: One reviewer had the front nose of the car done and was happy with the match on paint over 10 years old.

Q: Do you do exhaust work?
A: Yes. One reviewer had their exhaust done here along with body work.

Q: Are you open Saturday?
A: Yes, 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM.
